news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro, Inc. (NASDAQ:CLPT) Just Reported And Analysts Have Been Cutting Their Estimates
ClearPoint Neuro Reports Q2 2026 Results, Misses Estimates, Unveils $500M Long-Term Revenue Target
news.summary: Q2 revenue of $10.9M (+18% YoY) missed the roughly $12.7-13M consensus as operating expenses rose 51% to $17.0M, widening the net loss to $11.3M and leaving cash at $29.4M; the company reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $48-52M and unveiled a five-pillar strategy targeting $500M in long-term annual revenue, highlighting its new Torrey Pines CAL laboratory now in operation. Shares fell as much as 15-20% in after-hours trading.

news.headline: Analysts Trim Price Targets on ClearPoint Neuro After Q2 Miss
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue and EPS miss, sell-side analysts cut price targets (e.g., one target trimmed to $22 from $25, Stifel setting a $16 target) while several firms kept Buy ratings, citing continued confidence in the long-term biopharma-partnership pipeline despite near-term execution and cash-runway pressure.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience Receives FDA RMAT Designation for Parkinson's Cell Therapy Sasineprocel
news.summary: ClearPoint Neuro congratulated drug-delivery partner Aspen Neuroscience after its autologous dopaminergic neuron cell-replacement therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation, giving Aspen priority FDA interactions and a potential accelerated-approval pathway for a therapy delivered via ClearPoint's platform.

news.headline: BlackRock Discloses 7.1% Passive Stake in ClearPoint Neuro
news.summary: An amended Schedule 13G filing showed BlackRock now holds about 2.12 million CLPT shares (7.1% of shares outstanding) as a passive institutional investor, indicating continued index/passive-fund accumulation in the stock.

news.headline: CLPT Shares Jump ~32% as Partner uniQure Gets FDA Alignment on AMT-130 Accelerated-Approval Path
news.summary: ClearPoint shares surged after partner uniQure said the FDA agreed its 3-year Phase 1/2 AMT-130 Huntington's disease data could support an accelerated-approval BLA, targeted for Q3 2026 submission; AMT-130 is delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, directly tying its commercial prospects to the filing.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Partner uniQure targets a Q3 2026 BLA filing for Huntington's disease gene therapy AMT-130, delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula; a positive filing/outcome would validate the platform commercially.

catalysts.label: Biologics & Drug Delivery segment return to growth
catalysts.detail: Company guidance expects the segment (down 15% YoY in Q2) to return to growth in Q3 2026 as new CAL (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) preclinical/GLP services revenue ramps.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected roughly mid-November 2026 based on historical reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Oberland Capital financing option
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint retains the option (with Oberland Capital) to draw up to an additional $75M in tranches ($25M company option, $50M joint option) under its note financing facility before year-end 2026, plus a $1.5M equity participation right.

catalysts.label: Full-year revenue guidance
catalysts.detail: Company reaffirmed 2026 revenue guidance of $48.0-52.0 million despite the Q2 miss.

catalysts.label: First CAL facility GLP services contract completion
catalysts.detail: First signed statement of work for GLP services at the new Torrey Pines CAL facility expected to complete in H1 2027, generating multimillion-dollar revenue.

catalysts.label: Potential commercial approvals among 60+ biopharma partners
catalysts.detail: Management and analysts point to several partnered cell/gene therapy programs (including uniQure, Aspen Neuroscience) with a realistic path to commercial approval by 2027-2028, which would activate ClearPoint's fifth ('commercial') growth pillar.

pulse: ClearPoint's Q2 2026 print was a clear miss on both revenue and EPS, with cash draining to $29.4M even as management doubled down on a bold $500M long-term revenue target and a five-pillar growth strategy anchored by its new Torrey Pines CAL lab. Near-term sentiment is mixed: analysts trimmed price targets post-earnings while maintaining Buy ratings, and BlackRock's rising passive stake shows continued institutional interest. The bigger swing factor remains partner-driven regulatory catalysts — especially uniQure's targeted Q3 2026 AMT-130 BLA filing and Aspen Neuroscience's new RMAT designation — which could re-rate the stock well before ClearPoint's own commercial pillar materializes.
